title: Silvermoon City
body: Silvermoon has been the seat of the elves of Quel'Thalas since Dath'Remar Sunstrider founded it. In the Third War the Scourge sacked it, and the Dead Scar still runs through the ruined western half. The eastern half the magisters have raised again under Grand Magister Rommath. Travelers enter by the Shepherd's Gate beneath a statue of Prince Kael'thas, and from Sunfury Spire Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron rules in the prince's name.

parts.body: Silvermoon no longer hails its prince. Kael'thas has betrayed his people, and guardians who once cried glory to the Sun King now catch themselves and cry glory to Silvermoon instead.

title: Lor'themar Theron
body: Lor'themar Theron rose through the Farstriders to become ranger lord and second to Sylvanas Windrunner. When Quel'Thalas fell he led the survivors, and Prince Kael'thas named him regent, charged with guarding the land while the prince was away. Needing allies, he accepted the Forsaken's offer of aid, and he means to see his people take their place in the Horde as equals.

parts.body: When the prince betrayed them, the regent bade his people not lose heart: Arthas did not break their spirit, and neither will Kael'thas.

title: Grand Magister Rommath
body: Grand Magister Rommath served with Kael'thas in Lordaeron and was condemned with the prince's elves in the dungeons of Dalaran, a betrayal he has never forgiven the Kirin Tor. Sent home from Outland with a message of hope, he taught his people to draw arcane energy from crystals and other sources to ease their hunger, led the magisters who raised Silvermoon anew and conceived the Blood Knights.

parts.body: Once the prince's most loyal advocate, Rommath did not follow him into betrayal: he chose Quel'Thalas over the master he had served since Dalaran.

title: Halduron Brightwing
body: Halduron Brightwing is Ranger-General of the Farstriders, the post Sylvanas Windrunner held before the Scourge came. A veteran of the wars against the Amani, he once captured Zul'jin, who escaped by hacking off his own arm. During the invasion he saved his old friend Lor'themar, and he has stood for his people's place in the Horde, though he has never approved of the Blood Knights.

parts.body: With the Sunwell won back and burning again, Halduron oversees its guards himself, and no one enters his people's most sacred place without his leave.
